reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the Y and Hf co-doping intervention and its observed benefits (thermal stability, hot corrosion resistance) from laser-clad coatings (P2, P6) to a bulk alloy, and proposes a new application (fasteners) and a new predicted outcome (room-temperature creep resistance) without providing a mechanism or justification for why the coating results would translate to bulk or affect creep. The core idea is a minor extension of a single paper's findings.
